purpose: Prospectively test whether fixed checksum-valid Kraken depth-10 orderbook state adds useful decision context on preregistered XBT/ETH/SOL candidates while leaving the active V2R4 Paper baseline unchanged.

candidate_stream.eligible_pair_behavior: Capture H3 only for XBT/EUR, ETH/EUR and SOL/EUR. Other pairs are baseline passthrough and excluded from the H3 eligible sample.

supported_pairs.selection_basis: Frozen before V3-H3-ASSOC-002; no outcome-driven pair expansion or pruning.

source_contract.reconciliation: apply snapshot/deltas, trim depth10, validate Kraken CRC32 before state eligibility
source_contract.state_rule: latest checksum-valid state captured prospectively from the physical MINI-PC when the canonical candidate becomes visible

shadow_decision_change.causal_divergence_rule: Count H3 decision divergence only when the same-snapshot baseline control replay matches the official V2R4 baseline decision. Otherwise mark baseline_replay_unstable and exclude that row from causal divergence counts.

pilot_gate.low_impact_rule: If fewer than 3 causal baseline-vs-H3 decision divergences occur by the minimum gate, classify INCONCLUSIVE_LOW_IMPACT. Do not tune or auto-extend.
pilot_gate.fasttrack_note: No arbitrary day-count floor. Stop intake as soon as sample, temporal-diversity and capture-integrity gates are met; outcome review waits for required followups.
pilot_gate.promotion_limit: Shadow evidence cannot directly promote H3 into Paper or real-money strategy.

cost_reference.note: Same conservative project cost reference; H3 creates no orders.

evidence_storage.primary: Supabase public.v3_h3_shadow_evidence and public.v3_h3_shadow_status through authenticated Edge relay
evidence_storage.local: bounded MINI-PC runtime files and heartbeat
